name: MPC_PID_System
mission: Research-grade local-first web-app for layered MPC/PID, estimation, safety, experiment orchestration and bounded adaptive-control research.
invariants: UI never imports control-core modules directly; it goes through the application boundary.
Ground truth is simulator/audit data only when estimation is enabled.
Predicted feasibility and actual plant safety remain separate evidence.
Adaptive models remain shadow-only until a dedicated promote-and-rollback gate passes.
Production authority is never inferred from Constitution, CI, merge or development publish.
